meta.title: Song Maker — local-first music studio
meta.description: Generate a take with YuE2, separate tracks with HTDemucs, adjust the mix, and export locally with Song Maker.

landing.headline: From lyrics to tracks, at home.
landing.intro: Start with a style and your lyrics. YuE2 generates a take on your computer. Separate it with HTDemucs, then shape the mix in the app.
landing.localNote: Generation and audio work happen on your computer

mixer.ariaLabel: Interactive mixer for a real Song Maker generation
mixer.title: One generation, six tracks to explore
mixer.disclaimer: Real YuE2 generation · experimental HTDemucs 6-stem separation. Guitar and piano are estimates and may leak, especially the piano.
mixer.error: Playback is unavailable. Please try again.

facts.generation: YuE2 runs on your NVIDIA GPU
facts.separation: HTDemucs separates the take into stems
facts.privacy: Projects and exports stay on your computer

process.title: An idea becomes a starting point
process.intro: Keep control of the lyrics, generated takes, and mix from the first try through export.

idea.title: Set your direction
idea.body: Choose a style and write the lyrics that guide generation. A requested duration is a target, not an exact promise.

generation.title: Generate a take
generation.body: YuE2 creates a stereo render locally through audio.cpp. Generate multiple takes and compare them.

separation.title: Work on the mix
separation.body: Separate the take with HTDemucs, adjust the tracks and mix, then export in the format you need.

capabilities.title: Tools to shape the result
capabilities.intro: A local studio that takes you from generation through editing and export, with production tools available in the application.

generation.title: YuE2 generation
generation.body: Create a take from a style and lyrics using models stored on your computer.

score.title: Editable score
score.body: Import a MIDI, edit notes in the piano roll, and prepare a score for generation.

takes.title: Multiple takes
takes.body: Run sequential generations and compare renders to choose a starting point.

mix.title: Tracks and mix
mix.body: Separate stems, work with clips, and adjust levels before export.

export.title: Audio exports
export.body: Save your mix as WAV, FLAC, or MP3 for your workflow.

setup.title: Your computer runs the studio.
setup.intro: Song Maker is a desktop app. Setup downloads the required executables and models; plan for disk space and a compatible graphics card.
setup.licenseNote: This license restricts commercial use. Review the model terms before using them in a commercial project.

stems.question: Is output limited to four stems?
stems.answer: Standard HTDemucs separates vocals, drums, bass, and other. An experimental six-track mode also estimates guitar and piano; both can contain leakage, especially piano.

local.question: Are my songs sent to the cloud?
local.answer: Generation and audio processing in the main workflow run on your computer with local models. No account or cloud generation service is required.

hardware.question: What computer do I need?
hardware.answer: Generation uses an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA on Windows and Linux, or Metal on Mac. Check the setup guide for versions and dependencies for your configuration.

license.question: Can I use YuE2 in a commercial project?
license.answer: The YuE2/GGUF weights listed by the project use the CC BY-NC 4.0 license. It restricts commercial use; review the terms before commercial use.

closing.title: Check your setup first.
closing.body: The guide walks you through local installation one step at a time.

hero.headline: Shape your song. Keep it on your computer.
hero.sentence: YuE2 generates a take from a style and lyrics. Separate tracks, adjust the mix, and export on your computer.

promise.title: A starting take to work with, locally.
promise.body: From a style and lyrics, Song Maker generates a take with YuE2 through audio.cpp, separates tracks with HTDemucs, and lets you work on the mix before export.

features.title: Tools available in the application
features.body: Generate, edit, compare takes, separate tracks, and export from your computer.

yue2.title: YuE2 generation
yue2.body: Style + lyrics, CoT path (`cot`), local audio.cpp queue.

score.title: MIDI · piano roll · ABC
score.body: MIDI import, piano-roll editing, YuE2 ABC validation and export.

candidates.title: Multi-candidate
candidates.body: Sequential generations and an A/B comparator to pick the take.

stems.title: Stem separation
stems.body: Standard HTDemucs separates vocals, drums, bass, and other. Experimental six-stem ONNX also estimates guitar and piano, with possible leakage.

mix.title: Mix, clips, production
mix.body: Clip timeline plus production overlay (limiter, loudness).

export.title: WAV / FLAC / MP3 export
export.body: Deliver the final mix in the format you need.

lora.title: Optional LoRAs
lora.body: Pack catalog with an explicit CC BY-NC gate — no misleading badge.

remote.title: Remote GPU worker (unavailable)
remote.body: The prototype control still queues work locally and does not send a network request.

examples.title: Listen to excerpts
examples.body: These are synthetic player demos; none is presented as a real YuE2 render.

ambient.title: Ambient CoT pad
ambient.meta: Style: ambient pad · cot · seed n/a

gallery.title: Workflow diagrams
gallery.body: Design illustrations explain the steps; they do not show the real application interface.

license.title: Licenses — stay honest
license.body: YuE2 / GGUF weights are CC BY-NC 4.0. Song Maker is a personal prototype: no monetization badge, no weight sales, no commercial CC BY-NC claim.
license.note: Optional LoRAs use the same CC BY-NC gate in the app.

gpu.q: What GPU do I need for generation?
gpu.a: An NVIDIA GPU on Windows/Linux (CUDA), or a Mac that supports Metal. Setup downloads the models separately.

suno.a: No: a local desktop studio with an editable score, stems, and mix. No cloud social feed, no account to create.

os.a: Windows and Linux x64 with NVIDIA/CUDA, plus Intel and Apple Silicon Macs with Metal. See the installation guide.

commercial.a: GGUF models are CC BY-NC. Do not rely on Song Maker for commercial use.

cta.title: Open the studio.
cta.body: Choose the installer for your system. The guide will help you download the audio engine and models for first-time setup.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.body: Installation, first song, score, track separation, mix, and GPU troubleshooting.
